purpose: Developer-only external inputs for the existing pipeline benchmark, not bundled application fixtures or execution targets. SQLite adds moderate-sized real programs; it does not replace the retained Node limit/failure evidence.

preparation.runtime: Node.js 24 with the repository development dependencies installed (tsx); no additional dependency

windowsExtractor.prerequisite: Windows inbox bsdtar with ZIP support (current Windows 10/11); SystemRoot must identify the Windows installation.

preparation.behavior: Uses only these reviewed pins, verifies exact archive size/SHA3-256/SHA256 before extraction, extracts only the named sqlite3 member to bounded stdout, verifies exact binary size/SHA256 and format/ISA headers, and publishes under ignored .local/benchmark-inputs. Existing cached archives must match pins or setup fails explicitly. Never runs downloaded programs, changes executable permissions, or removes quarantine attributes. Both target formats are prepared on either supported host.
preparation.measurementStatus: Input preparation and metadata inspection only; no SQLite product benchmark or successful-stage result is claimed here.

provenance.downloadMetadata: Raw HTML comment headed 'Download product data for scripts to read', CSV columns PRODUCT,VERSION,RELATIVE-URL,SIZE-IN-BYTES,SHA3-HASH. URLs below resolve the exact published relative URLs against https://sqlite.org/; setup does not discover latest releases at runtime.
provenance.sourceIdScope: Published release identity, not a claim that the downloaded executables were rebuilt or their embedded source IDs executed/verified.
licenseFacts: SQLite authors dedicate SQLite code and documentation to the public domain; the primary copyright page permits copying, modification, publication, use, compilation, sale and distribution of original SQLite source or compiled binaries for any purpose.
The copyright page distinguishes deliverable SQLite code/documentation from build scripts such as autoconf-generated configure scripts, which can have other licenses.
The public-domain dedication is not a purchased warranty of title; the publisher offers a separate warranty where organizational or jurisdictional requirements need one.

This records SQLite's stated provenance, not an independent license audit of every linked platform runtime or other tool in the archive. Only sqlite3/sqlite3.exe is selected; no external binary is included in the npm/application artifact.
The download page identifies the macOS binaries as unsigned. Its instructions for executing them/removing quarantine are intentionally not followed by this static-analysis preparation.

binary.fileIdentification: PE32+ executable (console) x86-64, for MS Windows

inspection.extractionOutput: Captured as bytes and written only to the recorded binary paths; no target execution.
inspection.hashMethod: SHA3-256 independently matched using OpenSSL and Python hashlib; archive/binary SHA256 and exact byte lengths recorded from Python hashlib and binary reads. Header fields were read as little-endian integers; no application loader or target code was run.

retainedNodeBaseline.policy: Keep these actual oversize/failure observations intact; SQLite is an additional workload, not a fix or replacement for the Node evidence. Do not loosen parser/global limits to make Node pass.

macho.observedFailure: Default and raised import profiles fail resource_limit: Symbol count exceeds 100,000.

pe.observedFailure: Default import exhausts work at 1,000,001/1,000,000; raised import fails malformed_image: PE reference is outside a suitable mapped region (485.142084 ms), with no image published and revision 0. This is the pre-fix baseline, not a claim about current loader behavior.
